title: inspect.getclosurevars raises valueerror for an empty closure cell
author: tonghuaroot
body_preview: inspect.getclosurevars raises valueerror when a function has an empty closure cell. empty cells are valid and can be created when a captured variable is deleted.  report the empty cell name in unbound while keeping bound cells in nonlocals.   <!-- gh-linked-prs --> ### Linked PRs * gh-162207 <!-- /gh-linked-prs -->

author: CAESIUS-TIM
